description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

description.zh: 项目id，同projectId字段，项目唯一标识id
description.en: Project ID, equivalent to the projectId field, which is the UUID of the project.

description.zh: 工作项大类型，需求为Req，缺陷为Bug，任务为Task，风险为Risk
description.en: Work item category. Use "Req" for requirements, "Bug" for bugs, "Task" for jobs, and "Risk" for threats.

description.zh: 工作项小类型id，可以从ListProjectWorkitemTypes获取，对应字段为identifier。如果不填，则默认为默认工作流。
description.en: Work item sub-type ID, which can be retrieved from ListProjectWorkitemTypes (corresponding field: identifier). If not specified, the default pipeline is used.

title.zh: 获取工作项工作流状态列表
title.en: Retrieve the list of workflow statuses for work items
